summary: Iter67 — Ops Bulk Assign frontend flow verification (Playwright UI only, backend skipped per handoff). All 5 spec bullets green: (1) multi-select checkboxes + select-all header + floating action bar + Clear link, (2) BulkLocationModal cascade filtering for shared-cascade selection (chips at data-testid='bulk-cascade-chips') AND mixed-cascade selection (amber banner 'Selection spans multiple categories — only untagged Aisles/Racks are shown' with tagged aisles/racks correctly hidden — verified 4 untagged aisles, 0 tagged), (3) full assignment flow: Pick bin → qty + is_primary inputs → submit → POST /api/partner/inventory/locations-bulk → toast + modal closes + selection cleared on full success, (4) bulk-selected-chips shows product names, (5) regressions green: single-product 'Location' button opens LocationModal (data-testid='location-tree'), cascading Category→Subcategory filters still work (10 categories → 6 subcategories after selecting 'fruits-vegetables'), primary_location breadcrumb visible on rows.

issues: The 'Selection spans multiple categories' amber banner lacks a data-testid. Selector had to fall back to text matching. Recommend adding data-testid='bulk-mixed-warning' for stable automation. Non-blocking.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid='bulk-mixed-warning' to the amber banner div at ProductsPage.jsx line 805 for cleaner regression selectors.
critical_code_review_comments: BulkLocationModal.submit correctly calls onDone with the result payload so the parent can only clear SKUs whose status==='ok', preserving failed rows for retry — this matches the partial-failure spec.

cascade memo correctly treats a Set of size===1 as 'commonCat'/'commonSub' and size>1 as mixed; filterAisle/filterRack strip tagged nodes on mixed, matching backend cascade validation on POST /locations-bulk.

Floating action bar has both a Clear link (in select-all header, data-testid='products-clear-selection') AND a Cancel button (in the floating bar, data-testid='products-bulk-clear'). Both are functional; consider consolidating for UX clarity but not required.
Amber mixed-cascade warning banner is missing a data-testid (line 805 of ProductsPage.jsx). The three other conditional UI elements in the same header have testids — add one for consistency.

success_rate.backend: N/A (skipped per handoff — was 8/8 in prior iter)

test_credentials: partner-alpha-store@test.example / Alpha1234!Beta — worked. Warehouse MRT-ABJ-001 (wh_alpha_demo_seed) has 35 seed products including TEST_Cascade DAIRY/ANY/FV and TEST_Bulk fixtures — no seeding required.
seed_data_creation: None — existing seed catalog already had ample products across multiple categories. Verified test placed 2 SKUs into bin UB0294673e successfully via POST /partner/inventory/locations-bulk and modal closed with success toast.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Ops Bulk Assign frontend behaviour is green end-to-end against the live preview URL. Login → /partner-portal/martbaked/products. Test data available: TEST_Cascade DAIRY-b0696977 (dairy-eggs) + TEST_Cascade FV-b0696977 (fruits-vegetables) is a reliable pair for the MIXED-cascade path; TEST_Cascade DAIRY + TEST_Cascade ANY-083059a5 is a reliable pair for the SAME-cascade (dairy-eggs · milk) path. To exercise partial-failure result panel (data-testid='bulk-result-panel'), you'd need to pick a tagged bin whose cascade conflicts with one of the SKUs — the current tree filter hides those bins, so the panel currently only renders when the backend rejects post-filter (e.g., a race between browsing and warehouse re-tagging). Not a bug, just an observation.
